package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const LearningSessionSummaryPolicyVersion = "teacher-learning-session-summary-v1"

var (
	ErrLearningAnalyticsNotFound     = errors.New("learning analytics summary not found")
	ErrLearningAnalyticsUnavailable  = errors.New("learning analytics unavailable")
	ErrInvalidLearningSessionSummary = errors.New("invalid learning session summary")
)

// LearningAnalyticsSummary is a bounded Statistic-owned projection. It is not
// evidence of mastery or proof that a Student-owned session completed.
type LearningAnalyticsSummary struct {
	AnalyticsSessionID       string    `json:"analytics_session_id"`
	StudentID                string    `json:"student_id"`
	StartedAt                time.Time `json:"started_at"`
	LastActivityAt           time.Time `json:"last_activity_at"`
	WallClockSeconds         int       `json:"wall_clock_seconds"`
	ActiveLearningSeconds    int       `json:"active_learning_seconds"`
	LessonCount              int       `json:"lesson_count"`
	TaskCount                int       `json:"task_count"`
	QuestionCount            int       `json:"question_count"`
	SelectedExplanationCount int       `json:"selected_explanation_count"`
	CodeRunCount             int       `json:"code_run_count"`
	FailureCount             int       `json:"failure_count"`
	PassedTestCount          int       `json:"passed_test_count"`
	HintCount                int       `json:"hint_count"`
	TeacherInterventionCount int       `json:"teacher_intervention_count"`
	StuckSignalCount         int       `json:"stuck_signal_count"`
	PolicyVersion            string    `json:"policy_version"`
}

func NormalizeLearningAnalyticsSummary(input LearningAnalyticsSummary, studentID, analyticsSessionID string) (LearningAnalyticsSummary, error) {
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.AnalyticsSessionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.AnalyticsSessionID)
	input.PolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PolicyVersion)
	input.StartedAt = input.StartedAt.UTC()
	input.LastActivityAt = input.LastActivityAt.UTC()
	if input.StudentID != strings.TrimSpace(studentID) || input.AnalyticsSessionID != strings.TrimSpace(analyticsSessionID) ||
		!validUUID(input.StudentID) || !validUUID(input.AnalyticsSessionID) || input.StartedAt.IsZero() ||
		input.LastActivityAt.Before(input.StartedAt) || input.PolicyVersion != "learning-analytics-active-time-v1" ||
		!validLearningAnalyticsCounts(input) {
		return LearningAnalyticsSummary{}, ErrInvalidLearningSessionSummary
	}
	return input, nil
}

func validLearningAnalyticsCounts(input LearningAnalyticsSummary) bool {
	counts := []int{
		input.WallClockSeconds, input.ActiveLearningSeconds, input.LessonCount, input.TaskCount,
		input.QuestionCount, input.SelectedExplanationCount, input.CodeRunCount, input.FailureCount,
		input.PassedTestCount, input.HintCount, input.TeacherInterventionCount, input.StuckSignalCount,
	}
	for _, value := range counts {
		if value < 0 || value > 10_000_000 {
			return false
		}
	}
	return input.ActiveLearningSeconds <= input.WallClockSeconds+60
}

type LearningSessionSummaryResult struct {
	Session           StudentLearningSession   `json:"session"`
	Analytics         LearningAnalyticsSummary `json:"analytics"`
	Summary           string                   `json:"summary"`
	NextStep          string                   `json:"next_step"`
	ReasonCode        string                   `json:"reason_code"`
	PolicyVersion     string                   `json:"policy_version"`
	DialogID          string                   `json:"dialog_id"`
	MessageID         string                   `json:"message_id"`
	PlanningRequestID string                   `json:"planning_request_id,omitempty"`
}
